decisions.reason: Having survived the first review while adjacent care products were culled, the maintenance oil now appears to meet aspiration better than those alternatives and is likely to be retained as a complementary part of the floor-care system.

The moisture-protection underlay supports installation quality and cross-selling with core flooring products, so in a growing market it would usually be kept unless newer evidence showed a sustained shortfall versus comparable accessories.

The high-density underlay foam remains the most vulnerable because it is more substitutable and may overlap with other underlays, but continued industry growth and organisational slack still make retention more likely than withdrawal.
The oak parquet line is closely tied to the firm's core capabilities, brand, and strategic direction, so absent a clear persistent gap below aspiration management would normally continue it.
